rationale: Figure 1 compound 1 shows the tetrahydrofuran O-CH2-alkene-bearing-ring-carbon connectivity in CHEBI:80024, not the constitutional isomer encoded by MIBiG and PubChem CID 6436188. Adopt the pinned ChEBI default structure, including its stereochemistry; pinned RDKit 2026.03.5 reproduces its InChIKey. This is a curator adjudication, not an upstream source update or evidence that the two structures are equivalent. See issue #676 and research/2026-10-07-aureothin-identity-correction.md.

MIBiG BGC0000898 (AF079762.1; Xue et al., PNAS 1998, PMID:9770448) is the Streptomyces venezuelae des deoxysugar biosynthetic gene cluster and names compound 1 desosamine, but attaches the macrolide glycoside methymycin SMILES (HUKYPYXOBINMND-HYUJHOPRSA-N) and methymycin database xrefs (pubchem:5282034|npatlas:NPA01238), colliding with BGC0000094:1 (methymycin, CHEBI:29630). Split BGC0000898:1 onto the 3-star ChEBI structure for desosamine (CHEBI:32540, VTJCSBJRQLZNHE-CSMHCCOUSA-N) and withhold the methymycin xrefs.
